# Can we combine existing full-body skills during inference without retraining the policy for each downstream task?

> **Current answer:** In the skill distribution and short-time domain settings of BeyondMimic, future states and latent actions are jointly generated and integrated with waypoint, speed, keyframe, or SDF cost gradient during diffusion denoising. This allows the combination of existing skills without retraining the policy. A horizon of 0.64 seconds, guidance weights, state estimation, and transition transient limits are used to act as long-range planning or safe obstacle avoidance in the environment.

## Result

- In the skill distribution and short-time domain settings of BeyondMimic, future states and latent actions are jointly generated and integrated with waypoint, speed, keyframe, or SDF cost gradient during diffusion denoising. This allows the combination of existing skills without retraining the policy. A horizon of 0.64 seconds, guidance weights, state estimation, and transition transient limits are used to act as long-range planning or safe obstacle avoidance in the environment.

## Limitations

- A reliable tracker and state estimator provide the reported state/latent interface.
- Downstream objectives are differentiable over the short predicted trajectory.
